performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; purchase clustering exposes fragile conversion pattern, not fatigue alone.

findings.text: ROAS fell 60.32% week-over-week while spend held flat at ~$54/day; 28-day ROAS is 3.6x but last 7d purchases dropped 16.67%, confirming the floor is eroding.

3-day purchase signal (Aug 21–23): 0+0+0 purchases vs prior 3 days (Aug 18–20): 0+3+0 — six days of near-zero conversions despite $163 spend. Revenue is clustering around isolated bursts, not a steady flow.
OVERDUE: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 with no completed event recorded; fresh real-footage creative pipeline is stalled 10 days past deadline.

IG reach fell 19.72% week-over-week and 3-day avg (Aug 21–23: 469+887+avg) is trending below the 45-day mean of ~742 — top campaign BWS-Sales-Muslims ($844.26 of $1,495.29 spend) likely in frequency saturation on Muslim-audience pool.
GBP actions zeroed on Aug 22–23 (0 on both days) vs a 45-day daily avg of ~18; two consecutive zeros is unusual and may signal a listing issue, not purely soft demand.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from BWS-Sales-Muslims to a broad or retargeting variant to relieve Muslim-pool saturation; max 20% reallocation.
suggestions.monday_update: Move $15/day (~20% of the $844.26 campaign's daily allocation) away from BWS-Sales-Muslims and into a broader audience or general-audience ad set. IG reach is down 19.72% WoW and ROAS has dropped 60.32%, strongly suggesting the Muslim-audience pool is saturating. Success check: IG reach stabilises above 700/day and at least 1 purchase registers within 5 days. Re-evaluate by 2026-08-29.

suggestions.text: Escalate Live-Cooking Shoot 1 overdue 10 days; zero new real-footage creative blocks the only proven fatigue fix for this account.
suggestions.monday_update: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and has no completion record. Creative fatigue is the probable driver of ROAS decline (down 60.32%) and falling reach, and the SOW bars AI video — real footage is the only compliant refresh path. Escalate to Nacer (Ops) today to get a firm re-shoot or delivery date. Success check: at least one new compliant real-footage creative live in Ads Manager by 2026-08-31.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP for a third consecutive zero-action day; if confirmed Aug 24, flag as listing issue requiring immediate investigation.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP recorded 0 actions on both Aug 22 and Aug 23, against a 45-day daily average of ~18. This is currently a hypothesis — two days can be a data lag. Check GBP dashboard on Aug 24: if actions are zero for a third consecutive day, treat it as a listing suppression or suspension issue and escalate to Nacer immediately. Do not act on paid channels for this finding until the third day confirms.
